newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Cardoso approves Brazil's federal budget for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Cardoso approves Brazil's federal budget for 1997.

text.p: President Fernando Henrique Cardoso has approved the federal government's 1997 budget, a presidential spokeswoman said.
Cardoso put his signature to the 431-billion-reais budget late Wednesday and details of vetoes were due to be published in Thursday's official gazette, the spokeswoman said.
"This budget was discussed and negotiated at length. There wasn't much that needed changing," a presidential source was quoted as saying by newspaper Gazeta Mercantil.

Congress approved in late January a text of the budget which earmarked 208 billion reais for debt rollover and retirement, about 17 billion reais for investment with the remaining 206 billion reais due to be spent on payrolls and other costs.
